property_summary: After the CEO calls DrugDealer() and then calls seedMarket(1) with 1 wei, the reference sets initialized to true, so a second call to seedMarket(1) reverts (due to marketDrugs != 0 after first call). The buggy version sets initialized to false, so initialized() remains false after first seedMarket; a second call to seedMarket(1) also reverts (due to marketDrugs != 0), but here we check that after the first seedMarket, initialized() returns true in the reference and false in the buggy version.
change_summary: Change the assignment to initialized from true to false.
